purpose: Join selected-action anchors to explicit class-matched atom support, selected-event visible consequence support, and sequence-metric evidence-anchor support without creating terminal, sequence, possession, causal, progression, or tactical truth.

sequence_consequence.support_limit: Sequence metric evidence-anchor IDs are support-only, intentionally partial, and inadmissible unless all three payload bindings are explicit, non-empty and equal.

exact_join: all three input payloads explicitly carry the same non-empty match_surface_binding_id
explicit per-record match_surface_binding_id equality without payload fallback
explicit per-record actor_identity_candidate_id presence and equality
explicit JSON null actor identity is allowed only for non-actor-bound source roles; blank or whitespace actor IDs are invalid
selected-event consequence_class_candidate is explicitly present and non-empty
sequence metric evidence_anchor_node_id references an existing selected_action_node_id
atom_support_integrity: every supporting_evidence_atom_ids entry is a non-empty string before normalization
blank, whitespace-only, null or non-string atom IDs are conflicts and are not silently dropped
support_atom_class_counts total equals unique valid supporting_evidence_atom_ids count
normalized support_atom_class_counts keys must be unique
distinct raw atom-class keys that normalize to the same value are conflicts and may not be silently overwritten or aggregated
terminal_outcome_support_visible=true requires TERMINAL_OUTCOME_ATOM count greater than zero
derived_consequence_support_visible=true requires DERIVED_CONSEQUENCE_ATOM count greater than zero
atom class present while corresponding flag is false is a conflict
mismatched flag, class count, duplicate ID, invalid ID, invalid count, normalized key collision, or missing inventory blocks downstream promotion

admission_rules.when: terminal flag, matching atom class, valid atom IDs, unique normalized class keys, reconciled counts, complete exact lineage, required consequence class, passing payload-binding gate and passing module-hard-block gate

derived flag, matching atom class, valid atom IDs, unique normalized class keys, reconciled counts, complete exact lineage, required consequence class, passing payload-binding gate and passing module-hard-block gate
selected-event consequence class is explicit, non-empty and resolved; exact lineage, payload-binding gate and module-hard-block gate pass
only sequence metric evidence-anchor support is available after payload-binding and module-hard-block gates pass
two or more compatible support sources are visible after payload-binding, module-hard-block, exact-lineage, consequence-class and atom-integrity gates

required payload binding or record lineage is missing/conflicting; any module-level hard block exists; actor or atom ID is blank/invalid; normalized atom-class keys collide; consequence class is missing/empty; or flag/class/count reconciliation fails
no compatible support source is visible and all blocking gates pass
